turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, ma’am. Pip will go and call Estella right now.
turns.speech: Yes, ma’am. I’ll go and call Estella right now.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall wait for Estella in her chamber. See to it that she comes promptly.
turns.speech: I shall wait for Estella in my chamber. See to it that she comes promptly.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go and find Estella right away.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go and find Estella right away.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall be in her chamber, awaiting her arrival. Do not linger, boy.
turns.speech: I shall be in my chamber, awaiting her arrival. Do not linger, boy.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go and find Estella without delay.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go and find Estella without delay.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham trusted Pip would not fail her, she told him. She instructed him to tell Estella to be ready for her instructions.
turns.speech: I trust you will not fail me, boy. Tell Estella to be ready for my instructions.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip told Miss Havisham that he would tell Estella right away that she must be ready for her instructions.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will tell Estella right away that she must be ready for your instructions.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall wait in her chamber, as she has instructed. Pip may come to her when Estella returns.
turns.speech: I shall wait in my chamber, as I have instructed. You may come to me when Estella returns, Pip.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip will go now, Miss Havisham, and tell Estella what she said.
turns.speech: I will go now, Miss Havisham, and tell Estella what you said.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Be gone, Pip. And hurry back when he has delivered the message to Estella.
turns.speech: Be gone, Pip. And hurry back when you have delivered my message to Estella.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip went now and told Estella what she said.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go now and tell Estella what you said.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall await Pip's return. See to it that Estella is prompt with her lessons.
turns.speech: I shall await your return, Pip. See to it that Estella is prompt with her lessons.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip will go find Estella now, Miss Havisham.
turns.speech: I will go find Estella now, Miss Havisham.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall have no interruptions until Estella returns, she told Pip, and dismissed him.
turns.speech: I shall have no interruptions until Estella returns. Pip, you are dismissed.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go and wait for Estella to come back.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go and wait for Estella to come back.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham would have no more delays, she told Estella, and Estella must be made to understand the importance of punctuality.
turns.speech: I will have no more delays, Estella must be made to understand the importance of punctuality.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip would go and wait for Estella, Miss Havisham.
turns.speech: I will go and wait for Estella, Miss Havisham.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham saw that Pip was a diligent young man. But she told him not to let his attentiveness lead him to linger where he was not wanted.
turns.speech: I see you are a diligent young man, Pip. But do not let your attentiveness lead you to linger where you are not wanted.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip will go and wait for Estella now, Miss Havisham.
turns.speech: I will go and wait for Estella now, Miss Havisham.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham trusted Estella would not allow Pip to become distracted by the decayed splendor of her estate. His presence there was for a specific purpose.
turns.speech: I trust you will not allow Pip to become distracted by the decayed splendor of my estate, Estella. His presence here is for a specific purpose.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip who it was.

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that he was Pip, ma’am.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he was Pip?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip informed Miss Havisham that he was Mr. Pumblechook’s boy, ma’am. Come—to play.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham told Pip to come nearer; let her look at him. Come close.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he was not afraid of a woman who had never seen the sun since he was born?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip replied that he was not.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he knew what she touched here?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that he did, ma’am.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip what she touched?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that she touched her heart.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham exclaimed that it was broken!

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham told Pip that she was tired. She wanted diversion, and she had done with men and women. Play.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham said that she sometimes had sick fancies, and she had a sick fancy that she wanted to see some play. There, there! with an impatient movement of the fingers of her right hand; play, play, play!

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he was sullen and obstinate?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that he was not, ma’am, he was very sorry for her, and very sorry he could not play just now. If she complained of him he would get into trouble with his sister, so he would do it if he could; but it was so new here, and so strange, and so fine,—and melancholy—.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham remarked that it was so new to him, so old to her; so strange to him, so familiar to her; so melancholy to both of them! She asked Pip to call Estella.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham told Pip to call Estella. At the door.
